description: Unmodified real-style reference DCE+VFA example; the source that sub-02..sub-04 are derived from. DCE image lives in derivatives (desc-bfcz_DCE).
2x in-plane spatial downsample of the reference (downsample_x2 variant); tests resolution sensitivity.
Reference plus high added Gaussian noise on DCE and VFA (design noiseFrac 0.050; measured added noise ~3.8% of image std).
Reference plus low added Gaussian noise on DCE and VFA (design noiseFrac 0.015; measured added noise ~1.1% of image std).
Standard synthetic ground-truth phantom (Parker AIF, hematocrit 0, plasma AIF, relaxivity ~5.21). Tissue classes 1=muscle/fat, 2=brain, 3=vessel.
Standard synthetic ground-truth phantom with independently randomized acquisition parameters (relaxivity ~5.20, distinct AIF timing).
Higher-temporal-sampling synthetic ground-truth phantom (105 frames at ~6.9 s; 7 baseline frames).
Low-noise diagnostic phantom (voxel SNR 5000-10000, seed 42, extra 15-deg VFA, no VFA noise). Isolates T1/noise quality from DCE model-mismatch bias.
Low-noise, high-temporal-resolution phantom (725 frames forced to 1 s spacing, seed 42, 4 VFA). Stress-tests temporal sampling.
